name: LinkBreeze
short_desc: Self-hosted Linktree alternative with analytics, themes, and QR codes.
author: OmniRise
description: LinkBreeze is a self-hosted link-in-bio platform, the open source alternative to Linktree. One public page holds all your links, with a real admin dashboard, privacy-first analytics, QR codes, and a full theme engine. It runs as a single container backed by SQLite, the public page is fully server rendered with zero client JavaScript, and the setup wizard has you live in under a minute. Unlimited pages, a migration wizard that imports from Linktree and other platforms in about 30 seconds, 11 built-in themes, link scheduling, custom /go/ redirect slugs, email capture, and custom domain support. Your data stays on your server: no subscription, no tracking, no ads.
